boundary_refinements.final_refinement: The initial note treated the Asr/attendance mention as a finite variant. The exact appended wording only describes what a version mentions and supplies no own arrival predicate; it is now complete transmission context. The actual thirty-wasq father-debt clause and every other selected span remain unchanged.

The initial note over-weighted the attribution of the gold and two-hundred-dirham labels. Their actual role is to describe a version, without the purchase predicate supplied by other retained variants. Only those two complete selected labels per language move to source context. Every finite purchase, riding condition and the full I-think four-uqiya uncertainty retain their exact original component identities.

The immutable initial note treated the named Ibn Awn/Ibn Sirin reply as a report component. On exact source-role review, that tail expressly explains the preceding hadith steward rule when the hadith is mentioned; it is retained as attributed side explanation. This is not a general exclusion of Successor sayings, legal content or named encounters. Both complete Umar/Ibn Umar report components and all trustee conditions remain unchanged.

The initial note admitted the final narrator-labelled comparison as an anonymous interpretive saying. On exact source-role review it functions as an appended explanation after the actual Urwah/Aisha exchange, so that whole tail remains source context. The distinction concerns explanatory role, not legal subject matter or anonymous attribution alone. Aisha three components, actual verses/renderings and all meaningful predicates and conditions remain exact.

bukhari:2709.hi: Read the entire long Jabir field, including every appended version clause. The main report gives the father’s debt, proposed this-year-date crop, creditors’ insufficiency belief, invitation/notification instruction, visit with Abu Bakr and Umar, prayer for blessing, full debt payment and thirteen-wasq remainder with both7/6 alternatives, then the Maghrib encounter and joint Companion reply. Retain the this-year/crop scope and the parenthetic notify-me imperative; the mirbad drying-place definition is lexical context. The initial multistep route is context. In the tail, distinguish Hisham’s expressly supplied Asr-time/Jabir-attendance variant from the compiler’s no-Abu-Bakr/no-laughter omission comparison; retain the actual thirty-wasq father-debt addition under the explicitly printed Jabir voice as a qualified same-family transmitted clause. The terminal Ibn-Ishaq route merely mentions Dhuhr prayer without an actual new visit predicate; preserve it as comparison/source context and disclose all timing variants rather than choosing one. No missing actual attendance, uncertainty speaker or canonical link is invented.
bukhari:2709.ur: Read all own Urdu words independently. Preserve the this-year-date-fruit offer, refusal reason, actual tell-me imperative, Prophet visit and blessing, all debts paid, thirteen remaining and both explicit seven/six allocation alternatives. Jabir’s Maghrib encounter and the Abu Bakr/Umar joint reply are actual supplied content. Only the mirbad definition is lexical context within this main body. The appended Hisham/Wahb/Jabir wording expressly supplies Asr and Jabir attendance, then omission-only commentary about Abu Bakr/laughter, then the finite thirty-wasq father-debt addition with its printed Jabir attribution. Keep substantive variant/addition separate and qualified in the same family; the final Ibn-Ishaq Dhuhr-prayer mention lacks a supplied new event and remains visible source comparison. Preserve routes/context and do not harmonize the Maghrib/Asr/Dhuhr wording.

bukhari:2714.hi: Read the complete chain and short Jarir pledge report. The actual report is Jarir’s first-person pledge and the stipulated goodwill toward every Muslim. Keep coherent final hearing/Jarir framing; earlier pure multistep route is context. No prayer/zakat conditions are printed here and none should be inserted from2715.
bukhari:2714.ur: Own entire field supplies Jarir’s pledge and the actual every-Muslim goodwill condition. Earlier Abu Nuaym/Sufyan transmission route can stay context, retaining the final Ziyad-heard-Jarir frame and all actual pledge wording. Do not add the next occurrence’s other conditions or merge the source identities.

bukhari:2715.hi: Read full original. After the pure prefatory route, Jarir ibn Abdullah expressly reports pledging to establish prayer, pay zakat and give goodwill to every Muslim. All three source conditions and their universal recipient domain remain; no separate commentary or lexical marker is printed.
bukhari:2715.ur: Read the complete own Urdu route and Jarir statement. Retain the final actual reporter framing and all three pledging conditions: prayer, zakat and خیر خواہی toward every Muslim. Earlier multistep chain is context only. This is Jarir’s transmitted first-person report of his pledge, not an invented direct quotation by the Prophet.

bukhari:2718.hi: Read every word of this long original, including all appended transmissions. Main Jabir camel account supplies fatigue, striking/prayer, faster movement, one-uqiya sale after refusal, home-riding exception, arrival/payment, actual return attendance and gift with price not taken back. Retain the expedition circumstance, Medina arrival, I-attended predicate and explicit no-price-return clause. Distinguish each actually supplied riding-condition variant: Shuba route’s permission; Ishaq/Jarir route’s expressly parenthetic Jabir sale-condition; Ata’s explicitly reported instruction; Ibn al-Munkadir’s condition statement; Zaid’s instructed possession to Medina; Abu al-Zubayr’s permission; Amas’s ride-home instruction. Also retain actual one-uqiya purchase, four-dinar quotation, attributed one-uqiya-gold and two-hundred-dirham price details, Tabuk-return purchase with four-uqiya uncertainty, and Abu Nadra’s twenty-dinar purchase variant. All describe versions of this same source family, not separate independently verified sales. Keep pure multistep routes, corroboration-only clause, no-price omission comparison, currency-conversion explanation and final compiler majority/correctness appraisal as context. Preserve Hindi Ibn Jurair versus Urdu Ibn Jurayj literally; the unnamed first-person I-think-he-said uncertainty must visibly qualify its amount, without assigning its voice to an inferred narrator. Retain every supplied speech attribution parenthesis, return-from-expedition circumstance and bought predicate where substantive. Do not harmonize conflicting prices or silently prefer the compiler’s favored one.
bukhari:2718.ur: Entire Urdu field independently read through the final Abu Abdullah appraisal. The actual main sale/ride/payment/gift account retains its expedition setting, Medina location, return appearance and no-price-repayment negative. The seven supplied riding/condition formulations are finite transmitted variants with their own printed Jabir or Prophet attribution bridges, and the several actual purchase/price details remain distinct qualified components in the same report family. In particular preserve the explicitly parenthetic Jabir-said and Messenger-said words rather than discard them as generic parentheses. The four-dinar exchange-rate calculation is compiler explanation; corroboration-only and missing-price observations are apparatus. Amas one-uqiya-gold and Abu Ishaq two-hundred-dirham clauses are affirmative attributed version details, without pretending they are direct Prophet quotes. Dawud-route Tabuk-return purchase, unnamed I-think four-uqiya uncertainty and Abu Nadra twenty-dinar purchase are actual supplied claims, not harmonized identities. Keep the final Shabi-majority/condition/correctness appraisal in full source context, with no authenticity endorsement. All original spellings and inconsistent quantities stay literal.

bukhari:2719.hi: Read the complete Abu Hurayra account of the Ansar offer, negative Prophet answer, later work-for-fruit-share proposal and Muhajirun acceptance. Retain the after-brotherhood circumstance as actual temporal/social setting; the parenthetic Muhajirin label repeats the recipients explicitly named again in the resumed dialogue and can remain identity context. Keep all actual parties, the work condition, sharing consequence and affirmative commitment. Pure prefatory route is context.
bukhari:2719.ur: Own full reading includes the Ansar proposed orchard division after muakhat, the refusal, their subsequent work/share offer to the Muhajirun and the latter’s actual acceptance. Keep the after-muakhat setting and every substantive condition/voice. The parenthetic مہاجرین apposition is repeated by the later explicit recipient name and can be context; the named later dialogue remains. Initial multistep chain alone is omitted from reader text.

bukhari:2720.hi: Read the full source route and actual Abdullah report that the Messenger gave Khaybar land to the Jews on working/sowing and half-produce terms. The field calls the reporter only Abdullah, so do not expand to an unprinted patronymic from Nafi or familiar wording. Keep both duties and exact half-yield consequence; preserve the source typo दी जया करेगी.
bukhari:2720.ur: Entire own Urdu field supplies Abdullah’s report of the Khaybar land arrangement, actual Jewish recipients, work/sowing condition and half-produce share. Keep all substantive scope and the printed grammar. Do not identify Abdullah beyond the source’s own name; the earlier Musa/Juwayriyah/Nafi prefatory route stays context.

bukhari:2722.hi: Read the complete Rafi ibn Khadij report: Ansar cultivation/sharecropping, uneven productivity of plots, consequent prohibition and the distinct negative that silver rent was not prohibited. The prohibiting actor is not named in this own field, so keep the passive attribution qualified rather than call it direct Prophet speech. The rupees-and-so-on parenthesis is a lexical illustration of silver money and can remain context. Preserve the actual plot contrast and all negatives; initial multistep chain is context, coherent final hearing/reporting frame remains.
bukhari:2722.ur: Entire own Urdu read independently. Rafi reports their cultivation practice, differing production across field portions and being forbidden that arrangement, while expressly excluding silver rent from the prohibition. Do not infer the unnamed prohibiting speaker. ( روپے وغیرہ ) is an explanatory currency example, not new substantive narration. Retain every causal and negative qualification and the actual final reporter frame; no outside lease rule is added.

bukhari:2727.hi: Complete Hindi read including damaged introduction/stranded अलैहि वसल्लम) and all final apparatus. Actual Abu Hurayra report supplies the prohibitions on advance greeting of trade caravans, city-selling for a villager, conditioning one sister’s divorce, bidding over another and najsh/tasriya. Retain trade-caravan scope: without it the greeting prohibition broadens. Retain religious-or-kin sister scope as the actual domain of the divorce condition. Later corroborating routes, passive-form label and we-were-forbidden/forbade word-form comparisons give no new body and remain source context. Hindi lacks Urdu’s Nadr and some route words; neither names nor grammar are repaired.
bukhari:2727.ur: Read every actual prohibition and the full tail. The trade-caravan and religious-or-kin parenthetical qualifiers carry substantive object/recipient scope and stay; all named prohibitions stay literal. The tail consists of corroborating route and active/passive wording comparisons, including its own Nadr/Hajjaj names, not separate new substantive reports. Preserve these as context and do not import the Urdu route or Nadr into the damaged Hindi. No explanatory definition of najsh/tasriya is invented.

bukhari:2737.hi: Complete Ibn Umar report read: Umar receives Khaybar land, asks counsel, receives conditional retain-land/give-yield advice, then establishes the stated non-sale/non-gift/non-inheritance charity terms with actual beneficiaries and trustee-use conditions. Distinguish the advice exchange from the narrated Umar disposition while keeping one source family. (वक़्फ़) is a technical synonym and can remain context. The final Ibn Awn/Ibn Sirin encounter supplies an actual separately named saying about not intending wealth accumulation; this is eligible under its own speaker, not direct Prophet speech or an unvoiced compiler ruling. Retain (मुतवल्ली) as the explicit subject limitation in that actual final saying. No omitted beneficiary or canonical formulation is filled from elsewhere.
bukhari:2737.ur: All own Urdu clauses read, including the final reported Ibn Sirin response. Preserve Umar’s land/counsel scene and complete actual endowment conditions: no sale/gift/inheritance, all printed beneficiary groups, ordinary trustee need or provision to a needy person. The waqf apposition defines the preceding charity term and is context. Separately attribute the final no-accumulation-intention statement to Ibn Sirin as conveyed by Ibn Awn, retaining its explicit trustee subject parenthesis. It is an actual named saying within a narrated exchange, not a new Prophet quotation. Earlier pure chain stays context; actual deed and final saying remain in one source family.

bukhari:2739.hi: Read the whole Amr ibn Harith source, including the final-reporter kinship/biography and full estate inventory. The actual finite report is that after death no dirham/dinar/slave/bondwoman or other property remained except white mule, weapons and the land already dedicated. Keep all negatives, exceptions and prior charitable disposition. The multistep chain and attached Juwairiyah/brother/umm-al-muminin identification are introductory biographical context rather than a second historical event; preserve Amr’s actual reporter name and reporting frame. No external beneficiary, asset or canonical familial identity is added.
bukhari:2739.ur: Entire own field read. Preserve Amr ibn Harith’s finite death/remaining-property report, each negated category, the three exceptions and the source-dedicated-land clause. The preceding route and attached static narrator-identity/kinship explanation can remain context; they do not independently constitute another report. Keep literal narrator/name spellings without canonical identity repair or additional assets.

bukhari:2741.hi: Read the whole Aswad account of people’s Ali-wasi claim at Aisha, her challenge and personal death-scene account. The Prophet-related wasi parenthesis supplies whose executor is claimed and should remain. Retain both chest/lap alternatives and the explicit unresolved or-she-said qualification; the parenthetic instead-of-chest formula merely explains the already printed alternative and can be context. Preserve the request for the water basin and the head-as-subject parenthesis, since they supply the requested object and falling subject. Aisha’s lack of awareness of death and repeated challenge remain her own source assertion, not a separately proven theological conclusion. Keep narrator/transmitter alternative distinct from direct Prophet speech; initial pure chain is context.
bukhari:2741.ur: Own complete reading preserves the reported claim and Aisha’s actual question/denial, both chest-versus-lap source alternatives, basin request and the head falling before she realized death. Keep ( نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے ) as the executor relation, ( پانی کا ) as object description and ( سر مبارک ) as the actual subject. The small ( بجائے سینے کے ) explanatory formula can remain context while the full alternative and uncertainty stay visible under qualified transmission. No chosen location, external executor identity or implied completed appointment is asserted.

bukhari:2742.hi: Read every clause of Saad’s visit/will dialogue and final family circumstance. Retain the Hajj-al-Wada occasion, Mecca location and stated dislike of death after migration. The parenthetic Saad-ibn-Khawla identification of the separately named Ibn Afra is an appositional gloss; keep it in context rather than certify the identity. All/half/third questions and two negatives, the heirs-rich comparison, Allah-directed spending predicate, wife-morsel charity predicate, present no-need-for-will qualification and benefit/opponents-loss limits are actual source-rendered assertions/qualifiers and must remain bounded as printed; no independent verbatim certification is claimed. The final third-person only-one-daughter statement is actual supplied family circumstance, to keep separately qualified rather than turn into Prophet speech. Hindi’s initial Abu Numan spelling is not replaced from Urdu.
bukhari:2742.ur: All Urdu words read independently, from route through the final one-daughter clause. The visit’s Hajj-al-Wada timing and place remain. The Saad-ibn-Khawla parenthesis is unverified alternate-name exposition of Ibn Afra and can be context. Retain every substantive will fraction, refusal, heirs comparison, for-Allah spending condition, even-morsel charity predication, current no-need qualification and explicitly restricted opponents’ harm. These parenthetical source predicates are not merely dictionary definitions; preserve them without certifying reconstructed direct speech. The final supplied family circumstance has an unassigned narrative voice and should not be recast as the Messenger’s words. Source Abu Nuaym spelling remains its own.

bukhari:2744.hi: Read the full visibly abbreviated Hindi. Its route ends after Hashim ibn Hashim and does not supply Urdu’s named Saad/father link, so the first-person patient must remain qualified as an unidentified voice in this local shortened transmission, not invented as Hashim or borrowed Saad. Actual illness/visit, request, possible recovery/benefit and half/third dialogue are finite. The explicit yani death-in-Mecca paraphrase is explanatory context. Retain the parenthetic offspring domain because no-one-else would otherwise overstate all relationships. Preserve both much/large alternative words with OR, while the merely said-that comparison formula and amount noun gloss may be context. Final people’s one-third practice and stated permission are supplied historical/result clauses under qualified report voice, not an independently asserted legal ruling or direct Prophet quote.
bukhari:2744.ur: Own full Urdu does explicitly name Amir’s father Saad ibn Abi Waqqas as the first-person patient; preserve that own attribution without using it to fill Hindi. Keep the illness/visit dialogue, recovery/benefit possibility, single-daughter/offspring scope, both will fractions and the printed much-or-large wording. The yani Mecca-death interpretation and small said-that/amount comparison glosses are context; do not erase the actual alternative or child restriction. Separate the final people’s adoption of one-third wills and supplied permission consequence from direct quoted Prophet speech, retaining only the source’s claim and unknown scope, not issuing a legal opinion.

bukhari:2746.hi: Read the entire damaged Hindi historical account. The route omits the Urdu named Anas link; qualify the reporting voice as unresolved locally, not Hassan-as-eyewitness or borrowed Anas. The actual girl’s injury, sequential naming questions, affirmative head signal, accused man’s confession and ordered retaliation are finite own content. Retain Ansari participant scope and the parenthetic identifying relative clause about the man who struck her head: it ties the proposed name to the alleged actor in this identification scene, rather than defining a word. Preserve spelling defects सार/यहूदि and all original wording without repair or added conclusions.
bukhari:2746.ur: Whole Urdu read, including the explicit Anas final narrator. Preserve the Ansari girl’s incident, actual identification questions and affirmative signal, confession and the action ordered by the Prophet. The parenthetic relative clause specifies the actual accused actor at the name-identification point; keep it with the narration rather than treating all repeated finite content as apparatus. Earlier pure route is context. No additional accused identity or independent legal/authenticity conclusion is supplied.

bukhari:2747.hi: Read every own word. Hindi is severely abbreviated: after Warqa it has a stranded dual honorific without the Urdu Ibn Abbas name, and after the repeal clause it jumps to बराबर क़रार दिया without the male/two-female subject. Do not identify the speaker from Urdu or fill that missing inheritance clause; classify as a qualified source-transmitted historical/legal saying with damaged attribution. Keep the inheritance-property domain and every supplied child-presence/absence condition, fractions and recipient labels exactly. The source’s शहर spelling is unrepaired. These are attributed source assertions, not this project’s legal advice or an inferred canonical verse.
bukhari:2747.ur: Complete Urdu independently supplies Ibn Abbas’s historical account of initial inheritance/will arrangements and their stated replacement, including the male/two-female ratio absent in Hindi. It then supplies parent sixths, wife eighth/quarter and husband half/quarter with all child-status conditions. Retain the inheritance-domain parenthesis and all those conditions; removing them would broaden the claims. This is the actual Companion saying, not direct Prophet speech or an unvoiced compiler rule. Its named narrator and missing Hindi body must not be transferred across fields.

bukhari:2748.hi: Complete Abu Hurayra question/reply read. Preserve the healthy-state instruction, the source-supplied wish to retain wealth, hope of accumulation, poverty fear if it is spent, prohibition on delaying until the death stage and all ensuing allocation wording. The three non-honorific parentheses supply object/motive, spending-condition and actual final death predicate; they are substantive source-rendered qualifiers, not dictionary glosses, and should remain. No unnamed questioner identity or generalized independent ethical/legal ruling is added.
bukhari:2748.ur: Own entire Urdu field retains all conditions in the reported best-charity answer: health, desire to keep the property, expectation of more, poverty fear upon spending and the no-delay warning. The final parenthesis says the addressee has departed this world in the narrated death-stage consequence; keep the finite qualifier as printed, without polishing the doubled تو. Earlier multistep route alone is context; all actual answer wording and unspecified recipients remain.

bukhari:2756.hi: Read all Ibn Abbas source narration: Saad ibn Ubada’s mother dies in his absence, he asks about benefit from charity on her behalf, receives the supplied affirmative and declares his named garden as charity with the Messenger as witness. Keep mother’s source name, repeated absence, conditional question and actual declaration; they are actual scene details. Initial multistep route is context. No completed transfer beyond the declaration, new canonical link or repaired transliteration of the garden is asserted.
bukhari:2756.ur: Whole own Urdu report independently includes Ibn Abbas attribution, the mother’s source name, Saad’s absence, conditional charity-benefit question, affirmative response and the named garden declaration. Preserve all actual participants, mother-on-whose-behalf relation and witnessing words. The final garden name remains مخراف exactly; do not normalize it using another language or merge a similar occurrence.

bukhari:2757.hi: Read the full Kaab ibn Malik conversation. His proposed giving follows accepted repentance, whose supplied Tabuk-nonattendance parenthesis defines the actual past circumstance. Retain that circumstance, proposed giving in Allah/Messenger’s path, the keep-some reply and the actual decision to retain his Khaybar share. No completed gift of all other property is asserted. Earlier chain is context, with the final Abdullah-heard-Kaab frame retained.
bukhari:2757.ur: Entire Urdu read independently: Kaab’s own repentance/thanksgiving proposal, the reply favoring retaining part and his Khaybar-share statement are finite dialogue. The Tabuk-nonattendance parenthesis is the source’s actual repentance circumstance, not a chapter locator or dictionary definition. Keep conditional/proposed versus completed-action distinctions and the exact final reporter frame; no missing gift act is added.

bukhari:2759.hi: Read all Ibn Abbas’s actual interpretive saying: the rumor of abrogation, his oath/denial, complaint about nonobservance, two categories and the supplied gentle-response example. This is an attributed Companion assessment, not direct Prophet speech or the project’s legal opinion. The parenthetic reference to a title is source-navigation apparatus and should remain context. No verse text/number is printed or should be reconstructed from the topic.
bukhari:2759.ur: Own whole Urdu field supplies the same actual Ibn Abbas assessment and model wording, with all recipient categories and the no-authority-to-give clause. Retain these source-attributed assertions. Only the ( جس ذکر عنوان میں ہوا ) heading pointer is apparatus within the body, besides the prefatory route. Do not repair its grammar or claim a canonical verse identification not printed here.

bukhari:2760.hi: Read Aisha’s entire transmitted question/answer. Retain the parenthetic Saad ibn Ubada identity as the own source’s identification of an otherwise unnamed Companion, while not independently certifying a canonical match. His mother’s sudden death, I-think/she-would-have-given conditional supposition, actual on-her-behalf question and affirmative instruction all remain. Do not turn his conjecture into a proven prior intention or a completed donation.
bukhari:2760.ur: Complete own Urdu includes Aisha report, the supplied Saad participant apposition, sudden-death circumstance, explicit speculative mother-intention conditional and the on-her-behalf answer. All these are actual source content. Preserve the conjectural force and the source-local identification; no borrowed adjacent garden/property statement is added. Initial multistep route is context.

bukhari:2763.hi: Read the complete long Urwah/Aisha exchange and final narrator-labelled statement. Retain both actual quoted verse subjects and their source renderings, not as an invented recitation event. Separate Aisha’s first interpretation, her people-question/revelation report and her further explanation while preserving one source family. The full-dower exception’s can-marry predicate, guardian subject, family-standard scope and do-not-marry negative are meaningful supplied qualifications. The final explicitly labelled ravi saying gives a finite interpretive comparison; my initial judgment is to retain it separately under an unnamed narrator-attributed interpretation, not as Aisha’s verified words or direct Prophet speech. Its speaker remains unresolved; no canonical verse identifier or missing legal clause is invented. Pure preceding route alone is context.
bukhari:2763.ur: Read every Urdu/Arabic source character, including both exact verse quotations and their Urdu renderings. They are subjects of the question and Aisha’s interpretations, with her separately supplied people-question/revelation event; no external recitation is asserted. Retain the other-women qualifier in the first rendering, the can-marry conditional, guardian referent, family-norm qualifier and explicit no-marriage consequence. The final راوی نے کہا statement is explicitly attributed to an unnamed narrative voice and supplies a complete interpretation; initially retain as a separate qualified interpretive saying in the same source family, not relabelled Aisha or Prophet. No silent identity repair, omitted verse continuation or outside ruling is added.

bukhari:2765.hi: Read the complete Aisha interpretation, including the entire actual verse transliteration and Hindi rendering. The short Quran-this-verse introduction parenthesis is descriptive reference apparatus and can remain context; the actual quotation and rendering must remain as the interpretation’s subject. Aisha’s stated guardian/poverty/ordinary-use rule is her own supplied exegesis, not invented recitation or direct Prophet speech. Earlier chain is context; no verse number or missing Arabic form is imported.
bukhari:2765.ur: Own whole Urdu/Arabic field read, including the source Arabic ending بالمعرو as actually printed. Do not repair that truncated word from a remembered verse or Hindi. Keep the quoted text, Urdu rendering and Aisha’s own guardian/poverty interpretation; the parenthetic descriptive Quran-this-verse label is context. Preserve all wealthy/poor and customary-use limitations without certifying a legal conclusion or a recitation event.

bukhari:2767.hi: Read every word of all four actual pieces. Bukhari’s prefatory saying/chain is apparatus, but Nafi’s account that Ibn Umar never refused executorship is a finite historical practice report. The separate account of Ibn Sirin assembling guardians/advisers for an orphan’s interest is another actual practice report with unspecified transmitting voice. Tawus’s habit when asked about orphans is an explicitly narrated recitation of the printed verse and its rendering; preserve this actual recitation event. Ata’s final low/high-status-agnostic spending advice is his separately attributed saying. Keep four distinct components/report families, not direct Prophet sayings and not a single shared historical event. Do not discard these substantive reports merely because a compiler introduces the numbered entry.
bukhari:2767.ur: All four Urdu pieces independently read. Retain Nafi’s Ibn Umar executorship practice, the source-narrated Ibn Sirin consultation practice, Tawus’s actual verse-reciting response with full Arabic and Urdu rendering, and Ata’s actual status-qualified orphan-expenditure saying. Preserve their distinct source subjects/voices and independent report families; the unassigned reporters of the middle practices are not fabricated. Initial Bukhari/Sulayman/Hammad/Ayyub route is context. Actual verse words/translation are not source locators or an inferred recitation.

bukhari:2770.hi: Read full Hindi source with the visibly shortened/duplicated prefatory route and source spelling साड़ी/उबड़ाह. The Ibn Abbas report itself supplies the mother-death question, affirmative answer and actual declaration of a fruit-bearing garden on her behalf. Preserve all own words and source-local personal spelling without normalizing from Urdu; no unprinted garden name or adjacent-occurrence detail is added.
bukhari:2770.ur: Complete own Urdu report retains Ibn Abbas’s attribution, Saad ibn Ubada’s death/charity-benefit question, affirmative answer and the fruit-bearing garden declaration with the Messenger as witness. No garden name is printed here, so do not insert the name from2756. The fuller source route remains exact context rather than filling the Hindi omissions.

bukhari:2771.hi: Read the entire Anas report of the mosque-building command, garden-pricing request to Banu Najjar and their sworn reply that they seek its price only from Allah. Retain (मदीना में) as the actual only supplied location of the commanded building, not a duplicate name gloss. Do not infer a completed conveyance beyond the actual statement. Earlier pure multistep route is context.
bukhari:2771.ur: Own full reading preserves the Medina mosque command, Banu Najjar as addressees, proposed garden valuation and their actual negative/oath reply. ( مدینہ میں ) is substantive event location and remains. The final statement is theirs, not new Prophet speech; no sale or waqf completion beyond the printed exchange is invented.

bukhari:2773.ar: Read the complete Arabic independently. After the Abu Asim/Ibn Awn/Nafi route, Ibn Umar reports Umar obtaining property in Khaybar, informing the Prophet, the conditional charity reply, and Umar’s actual charity for the printed four beneficiary groups. Preserve the conditional in shi’ta, all beneficiaries and the source Umar/Ibn Umar distinction. This is a finite own-field report; it does not authorize filling the chain-only Hindi, Urdu or Roman siblings. Earlier multistep route remains context and the final Ibn Umar report frame stays.
bukhari:2773.en: Complete English field read. Ibn Umar’s account supplies the property visit, conditional reply, and Umar’s charity/yield-beneficiary statement. The parenthetic i.e. as an endowment is a lexical/legal rendering gloss and can stay context; the actual yield clause and all poor/needy/kinsmen/guests remain. No missing Hindi/Urdu body or endowment condition from another source is reconstructed.
bukhari:2773.hi: Read every word of the full Hindi field. The Abu Asim/Ibn Aun/Nafi/Ibn Umar route is duplicated and both copies stop at the dependent ki. No actual report body, action, saying or finite abbreviated content is supplied in this field. Keep the whole field as context and read the other saved languages before deciding the parent; do not supply an Umar endowment report by number or nearby wording.
bukhari:2773.ur: Entire own Urdu field read. It repeats the Abu Asim/Abdullah ibn Aun/Nafi/Ibn Umar transmission route twice, ending in کہ without a supplied report body. This is chain-only source material, not two narrations. Preserve the original duplication and inspect all other saved siblings before a source-only parent decision.
bukhari:2773.ur-Latn: Read both repeated Roman Urdu chains in full. Each ends at Ibn Umar ne ki and contains no substantive report. Keep the complete duplicated source as reviewed context. The independently present Arabic/English report does not fill this field.

bukhari:2774.ar: Entire Arabic original read, including final Anas framing, arrival in Medina, mosque command, Banu Najjar valuation proposal and their oath/reply. This is a finite own-language report. Preserve their negative exception ilIa ila Allah and do not infer a later completed conveyance. Earlier Ishaq/Abd al-Samad/father/Abu al-Tayyah chain is context; the final Anas report frame stays.
bukhari:2774.en: Own complete English field read. It contains Anas’s Medina-arrival and mosque-building report, the actual request for a price and Banu Najjar’s sworn reply.
